_description: Titan cost-estimator pricing table + telemetry endpoint. Versioned via harness sync. The toolkit maintainer (roles.governance_owner in titan.config.json) rotates models quarterly per Anthropic's published list. Telemetry SAS rotates quarterly — re-edit + rebuild .exe (or push via OTA in v1.1). v1.2 adds the 'correction' block (cost-of-hallucinations telemetry + spiral circuit-breaker) — all facts, no monetary assumption. Contact names live only in titan.config.json (contacts.people/areas) — never here.

telemetry._description: Telemetry config. SAS URL is NEVER stored here — it lives in Windows Credential Manager (keytar) only. User pastes via wizard during install OR via Dashboard input. auto_upload_enabled controls whether upload is on-by-default after the user provides a SAS.

thresholds._note: carrier_token_overhead = conservative floor for an active session (system prompt + CLAUDE.md + role + history). Used by cost-estimate.py when the transcript cannot be tokenized. Real sessions are often 20K-80K+.

caveman._note: Dashboard ESTIMATE basis for output-compression savings. 0.39 = measured multi-turn session saving (Better Stack caveman benchmark, Apr 2026; 10-prompt sample) — NOT the ~75% per-prompt claim; single isolated queries can be net-negative due to skill-load overhead. Replace with internal A/B measurement when available. Finance sign-off required before external use.

correction._description: Correction-cost (cost of AI hallucinations). ALL dashboard outputs are MEASURED FACTS: real cost_usd, measured minutes, counts, git/ADO records. There is NO monetary assumption in this feature — no hourly rate, no severity-minutes table.
correction._idle_note: Measurement bound: each human gap (assistant answer -> next user prompt) is capped at this many seconds so idle time (lunch, meetings) never inflates time-to-correct. One explicit bound, not a per-severity guess.
correction._tool_error_note: PostToolUse (telemetry-capture.py) classifies the tool_response TYPE only — never stores response text. edit_string_not_unique is deliberately NOT counted: that is ambiguity, not a hallucination.

threshold._note: Dashboard alert fires on the MEASURED rework-token ratio vs its own rolling baseline (median of the prior window x multiplier). No assumption in the alert. Suppressed until min_events_for_baseline events exist.

spiral._note: Real-time circuit-breaker in correction-signal.py (UserPromptSubmit). consecutive corrections >= warn_count -> visible notice; >= break_count OR episode_cost_usd >= episode_cost_break_usd -> inject a behavior-changing directive Claude sees this turn. Any clean (non-correction) prompt or successful tool result resets the counter. NEVER hard-blocks the developer. Escalation contacts come from titan.config.json (contacts.areas) via titan_config.py — pricing.json holds no contact names.
